page.layout: One page of text, one column. Top: verse in italic, with the initials "I. I. B." set right. Then an ornamental border. Below it: a centred title with a subtitle, then a verse paragraph opening with a historiated initial. At the lower right, a catchword.

p.i: Ut laude feris clara Nepotibus Crescat nitenti: nec proauis minor Virtute Maiorum superbos Augeat armipotens triumphos, Irásque semper fortior impias Frenéque Gigantum, tristia perfidus Quum veritati suscitabit Bella gregis furor Infulati.

main_text.head: NEREI VATICINIUM DE Ruina classis Ibericæ.

p.i: Quum Gentis tumidus rector Ibericæ Audaci peteret classe Britannicum Littus: quum celebres turpia tenderet Anglos sub iuga mittere: Ingratum cupidis nauibus ocium Turbato posuit Nereus æquore, Præuisas cecinit dum properantibus Clades, fatáque proxima, Lugubri patrias deseris aliæ[?] Oras, Classis, ait. Quo ruis impetu Præceps? O quid agis? fortiter occupa Portum. Nunc quid Ibericis

page.notes: Initial word "Quum" is set with a woodcut initial Q. "Frenéque" has a struck-through or overwritten stroke, read as que. "Irásque" has an uncertain accent. "aliæ" is printed like "alie" or "alice" and is uncertain. The last line "Ibericis" is probably "Ibericis" with a broken word continued at the catchword "Regnis", which is printed diagonally at the lower right. No marginal notes on this page.
